resources.string: Module stages were not requested in this boot. Start Shizuku, then tap Start module stages to continue without rerunning the exploit.

KernelSU loaded, but this boot has no verified module-stage completion marker. Start Shizuku, then tap Retry module stages. The retry uses KernelSU su -M directly and does not depend on the temporary-root helper.
Root is disabled unless model, device, fingerprint, build, SDK, security patch, kernel, page size and ABI all match.

Start Shizuku and grant this app permission before running. This uses a kernel vulnerability; a miss may reboot the phone. Root also starts installed Zygisk/Vector modules in the initial late-load, and the explicit module path restarts the Android framework once; this app may close during that restart.

An offline one-button temporary-root, KernelSU late-load and Zygisk/Vector module-stage installer for the exact Nothing Phone (3a) A059 Asteroids B4.1-260618-1048 firmware. It runs through Shizuku shell permission, never unlocks the bootloader or wipes data, and root disappears after reboot.
The signer-matched Root My Device KSU Manager is not installed. Install the Manager APK produced with the same native build; a Manager signed with another certificate will not authenticate.
